subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix message read/pins CLI output renders completely blank tables

question: Should Matrix `readMessages` return a deduplicated edited-message view to JSON/tool consumers, or should `m.replace` collapse stay limited to display projection while preserving raw timeline-style read payloads?
rationale: Both payload shapes can fix the visible CLI bug, but the broader open fix changes consumer-visible Matrix read semantics, which repository policy treats as a compatibility-sensitive plugin payload decision.

options.title: Accept Edited-Message Payloads
options.body: Use the comprehensive Matrix-local PR as the canonical fix if Matrix reads should consistently expose final edited messages across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

options.title: Keep Dedup Display-Only
options.body: Move replacement collapse into display/projection code if maintainers want `readMessages` JSON/tool payloads to remain closer to Matrix timeline events.

options.title: Split The Work
options.body: Land the blank-table read/pins projection first and defer edit aggregation to a narrower follow-up with its own payload contract review.

recommendation.title: Accept Edited-Message Payloads
recommendation.body: Use the comprehensive Matrix-local PR as the canonical fix if Matrix reads should consistently expose final edited messages across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a Matrix plugin/action-boundary and payload contract choice, and steipete has the strongest local history signal on those surfaces.
